title: feat: add independent activity navigation and chart selection
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds separate Usage/Earnings cards with independent dates, filters, and metrics. Calendars remember the day across month changes and retain mobile week view.
- Replaces chart tooltips with selectable bars that filter tables. Uses shared control variants and keyboard navigation. Escape respects portalled menus without Ark selectors; selecting the bar again also clears selection. Tables show the selected metric with matching totals, shares, and sorting. Compact Paid/Quest badges align left in two distinct columns.
- Simplifies Last events with combined source/amount badges, hidden visible headers, gray separators, and blue incoming/red outgoing arrows beside plain labels. Shows 15 events initially, with Show more adding 15. Missing billing source displays a plain amount. Event labels are Spent/Earned, matching the available API data.
- CSV exports depend only on each card’s date range, ignoring filters, metric, and bar selection. Uses existing APIs without backend/Tinybird changes; sample data remains local. Follow-up to #12790; addresses #12302.
- Validation: 15 date/CSV tests, TypeScript, Biome, shared UI/frontend builds, and local browser checks for navigation, filters, event colors/alignment, and missing-source amounts.

gist.headline: Charts grew little handles
gist.blurb: The activity dashboard now lets Usage and Earnings keep their own calendars, filters, and metrics. Click a chart bar to follow one day’s pollen trail into the matching table; click it again and the trail politely disappears.
gist.summary: The dashboard activity page now gives Usage and Earnings independent date navigation, filters, metrics, CSV exports, and keyboard-accessible chart-bar selection that filters each card’s table with matching totals, shares, and sorting.
gist.impact: Users can inspect a specific usage or earnings day without disturbing the other card, export by date range alone, and browse a cleaner Last events list that loads 15 events at a time.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy split garden dashboard represents the independent Usage and Earnings cards: two separate calendar flowerbeds grow side by side, while a selected chart bar becomes a highlighted plant that guides Polli to a matching ledger table. Polli wears tiny analyst glasses and uses a pointer; a friendly CRT monitor robot holds the two-card dashboard, with date leaves, CSV scrolls, and subtle incoming/outgoing arrow flowers.
